# CDK Code Review Guidelines

The shared review instructions have moved to
[docs/code-review.md](../../docs/code-review.md). Read and follow that document
before reviewing CDK changes.

When JSON output is requested, also read the
[automated review JSON format](../../docs/code-review-json.md), unless the caller
provides another schema.

This forwarding file preserves the existing instruction path. Maintain review
policy in the shared guide rather than duplicating it here.
